app.name: My Library
app.tagline: Know your library: your books, their authors, and their biographies.

home.title: Welcome
home.comingSoon: Coming soon: authors, places and books.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lockoutHint: After several wrong attempts in a row, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes to protect your account.

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: We'll email you a link to confirm your account.
register.passwordHint: At least 15 characters. Try a phrase of a few words you'll remember.
register.checkInboxBody: If {{email}} can be used to register, we've sent it a link to confirm your account. The link expires in 24 hours.

verify.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
verify.invalidBody: It may have been used already, or it's more than 24 hours old. You can register again to get a new link.
verify.errorTitle: We couldn't confirm your email just now

errors.too_short: Your password must be at least 15 characters.
errors.compromised: This password has appeared in known data breaches. Please choose another.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.busy: We're busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.request_too_large: What you sent is too large.
errors.network_error: We couldn't connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.signOutFailed: We couldn't sign you out. Please try again.
